<USER_REQUEST>
You are a Quality & Engineering Auditor reviewing Callisto's Graph Engine & Solver:
- crates/callisto-graph/ (all files in src/ including aggregate.rs, apply.rs, cascade.rs, commands/, infer.rs, plan.rs, tags.rs, toposort.rs, walk.rs, crosscheck.rs, resolver.rs)

Perform a line-by-line code audit and spec compliance review to identify defects #571 through #640:
1. Worklist termination and fixpoint convergence bugs in cascade solver.
2. Group version alignment flaws in Linked vs Fixed groups (Spec §G.6.7).
3. Pre-release mode transition edge cases (pre.json, exit mode, pre-mode severity overrides).
4. Command handler option propagation omissions (status, version, plan_publish, tag, pr_body, validate, snapshot, init).
5. Cyclic dependency resolution, empty workspace handling, monorepo name collision edge cases.

Use view_file and grep_search directly. Return a detailed technical report listing each confirmed defect with file:line references, classification, root cause analysis, failing scenario, and recommended fix/test.
</USER_REQUEST>
<ADDITIONAL_METADATA>
The current local time is: 2026-07-28T10:47:15-07:00.
</ADDITIONAL_METADATA>

I have sent the detailed code audit report containing the root cause analysis, file references, and fix recommendations for defects #571 through #640 directly to the parent agent via the messaging system.
